clips.title: The story
paras: General Marcus Jonathan sends word to Lakeshire while Redridge waits for aid. His dispatch acknowledges Magistrate Solomon's plea against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls, but offers no immediate reinforcements from Stormwind.

Magistrate Solomon sends an urgent plea to Stormwind City for troops to defend Redridge from the gathering Blackrock orc clans and Gnoll warbands. General Marcus Jonathan replies that the plea has been forwarded to the throne, but no soldiers are being sent now. He orders the letter returned to Lakeshire. Solomon is left troubled by Stormwind's delay and suspicious that something is wrong with its leaders.
